log.mic.mutedInWindows: 🎚 the microphone is muted in Windows — Reever hears nothing
log.mic.unmutedInWindows: 🎚 the microphone is unmuted in Windows ({percent}%)
log.mic.volumeDropped: 🎚 Windows microphone volume: {before}% → {after}% — Reever will hear you more quietly; another program changes the volume (for example, Discord auto gain in a call)
log.offline: 🔒 offline mode: web search and web chats are off (zero network traffic)
log.models.lazy: recognition models will load after the wake word or hotkey
log.languages.missing: ⚠ no model for: {languages}. Run the Reever installer again and tick its language pack
log.languages.needLid: ⚠ {languages}: a second language pack works only with the language detector. Run the installer again and tick it
log.models.bufferFull: ⚠ model loading is taking long — the audio buffer is full
log.models.unloaded: recognition models unloaded after idle time
log.anglicismsFailed: ⚠ the anglicism dictionary did not load: {error}
log.lid.unavailable: ⚠ the language detector did not load ({error}): every phrase goes to the first model
log.audioDropped: ⚠ audio lost: {ms} ms — recognition could not keep up with the microphone
log.ready: ✓ ready. Say «{wake}» and a command, right away or after the signal. The hotkey does the same without «{wake}». «{cancel}» stops.
log.noAction: ∅ no such action (add it and calibrate)
log.confirm.noAnswer: confirmation: no answer for {seconds} s — cancelled
log.confirm.unclearWaiting: confirmation: neither «yes» nor «no» — waiting for an answer
log.offline.webSearch: 🔒 offline mode: web search is off
log.offline.chat: 🔒 offline mode: browser chat is off
log.calc.badExpression.private: ⚠ did not understand the expression (private mode)
log.calc.typeFailed: ⚠ failed to type the expression into Calculator: {error}
log.calc.typeFailed.private: ⚠ failed to type the expression into Calculator (private mode)
log.chat.clipboard: 📋 the chat input field was not found — the question is in the clipboard, paste it with Ctrl+V
log.find.any: 🔎 searching for a file or folder: «{query}»
log.find.any.private: 🔎 searching for a file or folder
log.find.indexBuilding: ⏳ the disk index is still being built — try again in a few seconds
log.find.indexOff: ⚠ the disk index is off — turn it on in Settings → File search
log.choice.notHeard: … did not hear a number — choose in the window with the mouse or keys
log.choice.unclear: … did not understand the number «{text}» — choose in the window
log.choice.unclear.private: … did not understand the number — choose in the window
log.choice.missing: ⚠ option #{number} is not in the list
log.proc.notFound: ∅ did not find an open program «{name}»
log.proc.notFound.private: ∅ did not find an open program (private mode)
log.proc.protected: ⚠ refused: «{app}» is a protected system process
log.proc.protected.private: ⚠ refused: a protected system process cannot be ended
log.proc.confirm.private: ❔ confirm closing the program by voice: «yes» / «no»
log.dictation.start: ✎ dictation: speak — text is typed into the field with the cursor; it ends after {seconds} s of silence or «{wake} {stop}» (the text stays); «{wake} {cancel}» erases it
log.dictation.waiting.private: ✎ dictated → ⏳ waiting for an input field
log.dictation.dropped: ⚠ no input field — the dictated text was skipped
log.dictation.clipboardBusy: ⚠ the clipboard is busy — the text is lost
log.dictation.endClipboard: ✓ dictation finished ({why}): characters typed — {typed}; in the clipboard — {clipboard} (paste with Ctrl+V)
log.dictation.cancelledPartly: ↩ dictation cancelled: characters erased — {erased} of {total} (the window changed — the rest is untouched)
log.calibration.start: ● calibration — say the phrase for the action (several in a row is fine)…
